_comment: Single source of truth for trusted networks / Proxmox IPSets. Consumers: ansible proxmox_firewall (templates cluster.fw IPSETs), ansible group_vars (trusted nets → crowdsec_whitelist_cidrs), nix krg.firewall (monitoring source, service SSH restriction). Edit here only. Lives under nix/ because the flake can only read its own subtree. monitoring_host = the IP that runs Prometheus and scrapes the node/ipmi exporters (currently krg-prod, which hosts the monitoring compose stack). NOTE ON `ops`: those are per-admin RESIDENTIAL addresses, so they are DYNAMIC and go stale without warning — chris's rotated between 2026-08-18 and 2026-08-19 and locked us out of SSH fleet-wide (symptom: port 22 TIMES OUT while DSM web still answers 200 — dropped, not down). REPLACE a stale entry, never append: a residential address you no longer hold gets reassigned to another customer, and appending would leave a stranger holding an SSH allow into the fleet. `ops` gates SSH via nix sshSources, the cluster.fw IPSets below and the synology_security prepends, so one stale line is a fleet-wide lockout, not a single-host one. Do NOT add explanatory keys inside `ipsets` — cluster.fw.j2 iterates it with .items() and would render a bogus IPSet.

ops.comment: admin remote (sean) — unverified since 2026-08-19; may also be stale

machines.comment: fabricant.ucsd.edu (Proxmox hypervisor; AD domain member — needs the DC AD ports, samba-ad.nix sourcedPorts gates them on sealab+machines+ops)
